draft.subject: A quick hand getting Pioneer Ventures started
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

I know a new tool is easy to park during a busy week, so here's the short version: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go. If a reply is easier, just tell me what your team is tracking and I'll point you to the right starting place.

Best,
Priya
